methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $22M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Pipedream is a Series A transportation company founded by Garrett McCurrach and Canon Reeves that has raised $22.4M to date. The transportation sector includes 8 private comparable companies, among them Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, FleetZero, and REGENT Craft. No public transportation peers provide direct valuation benchmarks at this stage.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable and represents the primary valuation anchor. Using total capital raised ($22.4M) as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression yields $44.8M. A peer-median approach is not applicable; while 3 same-sector peers exist, none meets the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints within narrow filters (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier), and a broad sector median would introduce undue estimation error.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $38M (low) to $52M (high), with a median of $45M. This range reflects Stage-progression as the sole methodological pillar. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable Series A financings in the transportation sector with disclosed valuations, limiting cross-validation of the stage-step-up multiplier. Additional data on capital efficiency, revenue traction, or capital intensity relative to sector peers would strengthen conviction in the valuation midpoint.
